analysis.estimand: Strictly paired single-factor check that execution.node_process_delay_s moves ONLY the satellite node-processing stage: with PHY rate, routing policy, trace, topology and seed shared, the f2 arm must add exactly (packets x satellite visits x node_process_delay_s) to the realised end-to-end delay and must NOT change the independent per-link utilisation, the tx/propagation/queue phases, or the decision-compute reading. Descriptive structural check, NOT an effect size, superiority or causal claim.

planned_contrasts.estimand: Paired structural comparison of the SAME trace/seed/config differing only in execution.node_process_delay_s (0.0 vs 0.05). Tested property: the node-processing occupancies recorded on the timeline sink account for the e2e increase exactly, and no other phase moves. NOT an effect-size, performance or causal claim.
planned_contrasts.name: f2_vs_control

can_claim: the F2 node-processing stage is separately attributable on the timeline sink and is disjoint from the decision stage
adding execution.node_process_delay_s leaves the independent per-link utilisation, queue, tx and propagation phases unchanged on this fixture
the realised e2e increase equals the recorded node-processing occupancy on this fixture
cannot_claim: any algorithmic superiority, information value, learning value or new-mechanism contribution
an effect-size, performance curve, threshold or causal claim about node processing delay
real subscriber traffic or a calibrated demand model
that this design is executable by the canonical remote runner today: remote_job.py never passes the timeline stream F2 requires

design_accounting.independent_condition_rule: one independent condition per unique resolved config SHA256
